passages.text: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
passages.sermon:
The Lamb stood at the center of the throne.
The Lamb opened the seventh seal.
Heaven became silent.
The silence lasted about half an hour.
passages.original: Καὶ ὅταν ἤνοιξεν τὴν σφραγῖδα τὴν ἑβδόμην ἐγένετο σιγὴ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὡς ἡμιώριον

passages.text: And I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and they were given seven trumpets.
passages.sermon: Seven angels stand before God.\r\nI saw these seven angels.\r\nSomeone gave the seven angels seven trumpets.
passages.original: καὶ εἶδον τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλους οἳ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἑστήκασιν καὶ ἐδόθησαν αὐτοῖς ἑπτὰ σάλπιγγες

passages.text: Then another angel, who had a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense to offer, along with the prayers of all the saints, on the golden altar before the throne.
passages.sermon:
Another angel came.
This angel had a golden censer.
He stood at the altar.
Someone gave him much incense.
He received this incense to offer it.
He offered the incense with the prayers of all the saints.
He placed them on the golden altar.
This golden altar stands before the throne.
passages.original: Καὶ ἄλλος ἄγγελος ἦλθεν καὶ ἐστάθη ἐπὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου ἔχων λιβανωτὸν χρυσοῦν καὶ ἐδόθη αὐτῷ θυμιάματα πολλὰ ἵνα δώσει ταῖς προσευχαῖς τῶν ἁγίων πάντων ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ χρυσοῦν τὸ ἐνώπιον τοῦ θρόνου

passages.text: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
passages.sermon:
The angel held incense in his hand.
The incense produced smoke.
The saints prayed.
The smoke rose up with the prayers of the saints.
The smoke and the prayers went up before God.
The angel sent them up to God.
passages.original: καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ καπνὸς τῶν θυμιαμάτων ταῖς προσευχαῖς τῶν ἁγίων ἐκ χειρὸς τοῦ ἀγγέλου ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ

passages.text: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and hurled it to the earth; and there were peals of thunder, and rumblings, and flashes of lightning, and an earthquake.
passages.sermon:
An angel stood at the altar.
This angel held a golden censer.
The angel took the censer.
He filled the censer with fire from the altar.
The angel threw the censer to the earth.
Thunder sounded.
Voices were heard.
Lightning flashed.
The earth shook with an earthquake.
passages.original: Καὶ εἴληφεν ὁ ἄγγελος τὸν λιβανωτόν καὶ ἐγέμισεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ πυρὸς τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου καὶ ἔβαλεν εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐγένοντο βρονταὶ καὶ φωναὶ καὶ ἀστραπαὶ καὶ σεισμός

passages.text: And the seven angels with the seven trumpets prepared to sound them.
passages.sermon:
Seven angels stood ready.
Each angel held a trumpet.
The angels prepared themselves.
They prepared to sound their trumpets.
passages.original: Καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ ἄγγελοι οἱ ἔχοντες τὰς ἑπτὰ σάλπιγγας ἡτοίμασαν αὑτοὺς ἵνα σαλπίσωσιν

passages.text: Then the first angel sounded his trumpet, and hail and fire mixed with blood were hurled down upon the earth. A third of the earth was burned up, along with a third of the trees and all the green grass.
passages.sermon:
The first angel stood ready.
The first angel had a trumpet.
The first angel sounded his trumpet.
Hail fell on the earth.
Fire fell on the earth.
Blood mixed with the hail and fire.
Hail, fire, and blood were thrown down to the earth.
A third of the earth burned up.
A third of the trees burned up.
All the green grass burned up.
passages.original: Καὶ ὁ πρῶτος ἐσάλπισεν καὶ ἐγένετο χάλαζα καὶ πῦρ μεμιγμένα ἐν αἵματι καὶ ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν γῆν καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῆς γῆς κατεκάη καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῶν δένδρων κατεκάη καὶ πᾶς χόρτος χλωρὸς κατεκάη

passages.text: Then the second angel sounded his trumpet, and something like a great mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood, a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
passages.sermon:
Seven angels each held a trumpet.
The second angel stood ready.
The second angel sounded his trumpet.
Something like a great mountain appeared.
This mountain burned with fire.
Someone threw this burning mountain into the sea.
A third of the sea turned into blood.
A third of the living creatures in the sea died.
A third of the ships in the sea were destroyed.
passages.original: Καὶ ὁ δεύτερος ἄγγελος ἐσάλπισεν καὶ ὡς ὄρος μέγα πυρὶ καιόμενον ἐβλήθη εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ τρίτον τῆς θαλάσσης αἷμα καὶ ἀπέθανεν τὸ τρίτον τῶν κτισμάτων τῶν ἐν τῇ θαλάσσῃ τὰ ἔχοντα ψυχάς καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῶν πλοίων διεφθάρησαν

passages.text: Then the third angel sounded his trumpet, and a great star burning like a torch fell from heaven and landed on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water.
passages.sermon:
The third angel sounded his trumpet.
A great star fell from heaven.
The star burned like a torch.
The star landed on a third of the rivers.
The star also landed on the springs of water.
passages.original: Καὶ ὁ τρίτος ἄγγελος ἐσάλπισεν καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀστὴρ μέγας καιόμενος ὡς λαμπάς καὶ ἔπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸ τρίτον τῶν ποταμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰς πηγὰς τῶν ὑδάτων

passages.text: The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters turned bitter like wormwood oil, and many people died from the bitter waters.
passages.sermon:
The star has a name.
Its name is Wormwood.
A third of the waters became bitter like wormwood.
Many people died from these waters.
The waters became bitter.
passages.original: καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ ἀστέρος λέγεται Ὁ Ἄψινθος καὶ ἐγένετο τὸ τρίτον τῶν ὑδάτων εἰς ἄψινθον καὶ πολλοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀπέθανον ἐκ τῶν ὑδάτων ὅτι ἐπικράνθησαν

passages.text: Then the fourth angel sounded his trumpet, and a third of the sun and moon and stars were struck. A third of the stars were darkened, a third of the day was without light, and a third of the night as well.
passages.sermon:
The fourth angel sounded his trumpet.
A third of the sun was struck.
A third of the moon was struck.
A third of the stars was struck.
A third of the sun became dark.
A third of the moon became dark.
A third of the stars became dark.
A third of the day had no light.
A third of the night had no light.
passages.original: Καὶ ὁ τέταρτος ἄγγελος ἐσάλπισεν καὶ ἐπλήγη τὸ τρίτον τοῦ ἡλίου καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῆς σελήνης καὶ τὸ τρίτον τῶν ἀστέρων ἵνα σκοτισθῇ τὸ τρίτον αὐτῶν καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα μὴ φάνῃ τὸ τρίτον αὐτῆς καὶ ἡ νὺξ ὁμοίως

passages.text: And as I observed, I heard an eagle flying overhead, calling in a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the trumpet blasts about to be sounded by the remaining three angels!”
passages.sermon:
I saw an eagle.
The eagle was flying high in the sky.
I heard the eagle speak with a loud voice.
The eagle said, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who live on the earth.”
The eagle warned about what will happen next.
The eagle spoke about the trumpet blasts.
Three angels have not yet sounded their trumpets.
The eagle warned that these three angels will sound their trumpets soon.
The eagle said trouble will come because of these trumpet blasts.
passages.original: Καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἤκουσα ἑνὸς ἀετοῦ πετομένου ἐν μεσουρανήματι λέγοντος φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Οὐαὶ οὐαὶ οὐαὶ τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐκ τῶν λοιπῶν φωνῶν τῆς σάλπιγγος τῶν τριῶν ἀγγέλων τῶν μελλόντων σαλπίζειν
